scope: Domain-agnostic iterative scientific graph with biological historical forecasting, 16-hour mockable hackathon MVP, scoped branch-selection guarantees and frontend demo design.

sources.title: Dyport
sources.author: Ilya Tyagin and Ilya Safro
sources.claim: Temporal biomedical association benchmark and negative sampling protocol
sources.evidence: Methods describe curated database and MEDLINE pair intersection, date slicing and type-matched negative candidates
sources.access: parent read full-text HTML; metadata header contains stale conference-template fields, so use arXiv submission date

sources.title: Dyport repository and released predictions
sources.author: IlyaTyagin
sources.claim: Actual per-row baseline predictions and yearly labels available
sources.evidence: Complete 80,495,323-byte 2016 CSV downloaded; 336,710 rows; six model families; metrics recomputed
sources.access: local file and sha256 in dyport-access.json; underlying pre-2016 graph absent from score file

sources.title: CIViC data releases
sources.author: CIViC
sources.claim: Compact historical evidence graphs and provenance available
sources.evidence: Complete TSV downloads parsed: 2,372 and 3,888 evidence rows
sources.access: public downloads; schema and vocabulary changes observed; artifact metadata in civic-access.json

sources.title: PubTator3 API
sources.author: NCBI/NLM/NIH
sources.claim: Normalized entities and typed relation export can supply graph evidence
sources.evidence: PMID 29355051 HTTP200; 14,167-byte JSON; PubTator3 list wrapper; three relations and passage publication year
sources.access: direct public API executed; rate limit documented as three requests per second

sources.title: BioVerge
sources.author: Fuyi Yang et al.
sources.claim: Useful typed graph and agent baseline scaffold but supplied endpoints limit open recommendation claim
sources.evidence: Paper describes historical knowledge, 177 diabetes triples, generation/evaluation modules and exact versus LLM-judged metrics
sources.access: paper and repository read; linked full dataset not downloaded in this pass

sources.title: AGATHA repository
sources.author: Justin Sybrandt et al.
sources.claim: Relevant biomedical hypothesis generation comparator; pretrained package 38.5 GB
sources.access: source documentation read; cached AGATHA scores used instead of model installation

sources.title: BioRED public archive
sources.author: NCBI
sources.claim: Small normalized relation corpus useful for fixtures
sources.evidence: Asset agent downloaded 2,191,684-byte archive in memory and inspected annotation files
sources.access: worker direct archive inspection; not saved locally

sources.title: Science4Cast
sources.author: IARAI competition authors
sources.claim: Prior art for future semantic graph edges
sources.evidence: Repo describes 64k AI concepts, pre-2018 graph and 2017–2020 future links
sources.access: primary repository read; non-biological methodological reference

sources.title: Mat2vec
sources.author: Tshitoyan et al.
sources.evidence: Author repository and paper describe historical materials recommendations
sources.access: repo and author manuscript read; excluded as flagship after biological-domain clarification

sources.title: An analysis of approximations for maximizing submodular set functions—I
sources.author: Nemhauser, Wolsey and Fisher
sources.claim: Greedy coverage approximation under cardinality constraint
sources.evidence: Abstract and theorem give 1-((k-1)/k)^k for normalized monotone submodular objective
sources.access: original paper PDF read; independent agent review plus finite exhaustive probe

sources.title: A threshold of ln n for approximating set cover
sources.author: Uri Feige
sources.claim: General maximum-coverage approximation barrier, not difficulty of fixed k=2
sources.evidence: Primary hardness result for max k-cover; report restricts asymptotic claim to general input

sources.title: Online Bandit Learning against an Adaptive Adversary: from Regret to Policy Regret
sources.author: Arora, Dekel and Tewari
sources.claim: External regret cannot simply compare action-dependent graph trajectories
sources.evidence: Paper defines policy regret and impossibility for unrestricted adaptive adversaries

sources.title: Super-Exponential Regret for UCT, AlphaGo and Variants
sources.author: Orseau and Munos
sources.claim: MCTS/UCT does not supply blanket useful logarithmic regret for this harness
sources.evidence: Paper corrects earlier lower-bound oversight and establishes severe worst cases
sources.access: parent paper abstract read; original 2007 theory also reviewed
